description: This file defines the DatabaseQueue class implementing queue operations using a database backend in Drupal, including creating, claiming, releasing, delaying, deleting items, and managing the queue schema.

classes.name: DatabaseQueue
classes.description: Implements a queue using a database table, supporting reliable queue operations, garbage collection, and delayable queue features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the queue with a name and database connection.

methods.name: createItem
methods.description: Creates a new queue item with the provided data, ensuring the queue table exists.

methods.name: doCreateItem
methods.description: Inserts a serialized data item into the queue table and returns its ID.

methods.name: numberOfItems
methods.description: Returns the count of items in the queue.

methods.name: claimItem
methods.description: Claims an item from the queue for processing, updating its expiry time.

methods.name: releaseItem
methods.description: Releases a claimed item back to the queue.

methods.name: delayItem
methods.description: Delays processing of an item by updating its expiry time.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes an item from the queue.

methods.name: createQueue
methods.description: Creates the queue (no-op as table is created on demand).

methods.name: garbageCollection
methods.description: Performs cleanup of failed batches and resets expired items.

methods.name: ensureTableExists
methods.description: Checks if the queue table exists and creates it if not.

methods.name: catchException
methods.description: Handles exceptions, rethrowing if the table exists.

methods.name: schemaDefinition
methods.description: Defines the schema for the queue table.
